notes.title: BSWW: Battle Strike World War is going free to play
notes.notes:
Battle Strike World War, which helped battle royales become one of the most popular genres in gaming, is finally going free to play on Jan, 1st, 2022. Rimzaa Soft made the announcement at The Game Awards 2021 on Tuesday evening.

After BSWW: Battle Strike World War becomes free-to-play, it will also introduce a new premium account called Battle Plus. This offers players extra currency, a Ranked Mode, Custom Match functionality, in-game items, and other bonuses. The account upgrade comes with a one-time fee of $1.99, but the features are optional to the core BSWW Experience

Players who have already purchased and played BSWW before its transition to free-to-play will get a special pack that includes a free Battle pass Plus account upgrade and special cosmetic items. The free-to-play version of BSWW is available on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows PC via Steam.

notes.title: Steam Achievements are now Available for Battle Strike World War
notes.notes: There are currently 10 Steam Achievements for Battle Strike World War. These are unlocked in Steam after you complete the challenges in-game.
